shortBulletSummary: Crypto market dips with BTC around $79K and ETH at $2455, while stablecoins remain steady.
Fed Waller's comments reduce rate hike fears, but a strong US jobs report complicates the outlook, with ~50% odds for a September hike.
Major UK firm Hargreaves Lansdown now provides Bitcoin and crypto ETNs.
The CLARITY Act vote on September 15th is critical for US crypto regulation, though it faces low passage odds (14%).
Binance Coin (BNB) sees a rise following its Pasteur upgrade and listing on Kalshi perpetual futures.
